name: CI Evidence Pack Reference: Deterministic Audit Adoption Path
description: Reference implementation for the v0.8 CI adoption path. The scenario runs the current mumei-agent audit CLI in deterministic/no-LLM mode, derives a migration plan, verifies a reviewed .mm reference contract, and packages the artifacts with explicit evidence boundaries for GitHub Actions.

harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate a reproducible GitHub Actions evidence-pack shape using only the current audit CLI contract while SARIF, baseline, and fail-on policy support remain unavailable upstream.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: scenarios/ci_evidence_pack/src/ledger.py, reference/safe_divide.mm, and reference/workflows/mumei-audit.yml.
Run inputs: the current mumei-agent audit CLI with LLM_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY explicitly empty, plus the local mumei verifier.
Generate evidence: evidence-pack/audit.json, migration_plan.json, verification.json, reference.proof.json, github-actions-mumei-audit.yml, summary.md, manifest.json, and verifier logs.
Boundary: audit output is not a proof certificate; migration_plan.json is not a completed migration; reference.proof.json proves only the reviewed reference .mm contract.

Artifact roles: audit.json, migration_plan.json, and manifest.json carry a closed artifact_paths map; native_bundle and adapter_observation are null and must not be relabeled from audit/migration/proof artifacts.
SARIF boundary: audit.sarif is intentionally absent until mumei-agent emits it; this scenario must not fabricate SARIF in mumei-demo.
notes: The scenario uses the current audit CLI because mumei-agent A-1/A-2 CI contracts are still independent upstream work.
deterministic/no-LLM means the audit child process receives empty LLM_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY values; it does not mean every upstream extraction ambiguity is resolved.
The reference workflow uploads SARIF only conditionally, when a future audit CLI writes evidence-pack/audit.sarif.

intro: Step 1: Run the current audit CLI deterministically against the reference fixture
Step 2: Pack audit, migration-plan, reference-certificate, workflow, and boundary evidence for CI review
narrative.before: A repository owner can read audit JSON manually, but there is no compact reference showing which files belong in a CI evidence pack or where the trust boundary lies.
narrative.after: CI uploads one evidence pack containing the current audit contract, migration plan, reference .mm proof certificate, copyable workflow, and explicit non-claims.

pass.headline: CI evidence pack built with deterministic audit and explicit boundaries
follow_up: audit.sarif is absent by design until the upstream CLI emits SARIF
migration hints remain human-review input rather than verified migration evidence

steps.name: Build deterministic CI audit evidence pack
expected_patterns: deterministic audit mode: no LLM credentials
artifact_contract: evidence-pack/audit.json preserves the current fixed audit keys and records the raw audit CLI exit code without interpreting it as a future fail-on policy.
evidence-pack/migration_plan.json is derived only from migration_hints and marks every candidate human_review_required.
evidence-pack/reference.proof.json is produced by mumei verify and rechecked by mumei verify-cert --strict for reference/safe_divide.mm.
evidence-pack/manifest.json binds artifact SHA-256 values, keeps native_bundle and adapter_observation absent in artifact_paths, and states that no Python/.mm semantic equivalence is established.
evidence-pack/github-actions-mumei-audit.yml is copied byte-for-byte from the reviewed reference workflow template.
steps.verifier_gate: The builder exits 0, audit JSON contains every fixed key, migration_hints yields at least one high-priority review candidate for the division fixture, the reference proof certificate has all_verified=true, and manifest.json declares SARIF as not_available_in_current_cli.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: v0.8 D-1: provide a deterministic GitHub Actions reference scenario and public evidence pack without changing the audit CLI contract or waiting for upstream SARIF/baseline support.
success_criteria: The current audit CLI runs with no LLM credentials and its fixed JSON keys are preserved.
The pack contains audit, migration plan, proof-certificate path, workflow template, summary, and manifest artifacts.
SARIF absence is explicit and no demo-side SARIF file is fabricated.
Evidence boundaries separate audit findings, migration scaffolding, reference contract proof, and implementation equivalence.
expected_user_observable_behavior: A reviewer can download one CI artifact and understand what each file does and does not prove.
A repository owner can copy the reference workflow shape and adjust AUDIT_TARGET for its own source tree.
CI does not fail because audit.sarif is absent before upstream SARIF support exists.
intent_fidelity.drift_risk: Upstream audit output can improve or change verdicts; the scenario gates the fixed key contract and deterministic invocation rather than a specific future SARIF or baseline format.

success_criteria: evidence-pack/audit.json includes all current fixed audit keys
evidence-pack/migration_plan.json contains the divide migration review candidate
evidence-pack/github-actions-mumei-audit.yml conditionally uploads SARIF only when the file exists
result_message: Result: deterministic CI evidence pack built; SARIF and baseline boundaries are explicit.
